_why: SHIELD UPCAST FALLBACK smoke test (2026-11-08): levels a wizard to 3 for real (so the 4/2 slot split is genuinely computed, not overridden -- wizard_spell_slots_max turns out to be a derived stat too, recomputed on preset/level changes, so overriding it directly doesn't stick), drains all 4 first-level slots with four real Ray of Sickness casts against a poison-immune Zombie (0 damage each time, so it never dies and the fight never ends early), then arms Shield with only the 2nd-level pool left and confirms it fires from that pool on a blockable hit (Zombie +3 vs AC 11, rand=mid roll 11 totals 14 -- hit, not nat 20, under AC+5).
label: dev_scene_select

stats.wizard_spell_2_desc: Ray of Sickness—a sickly green ray of raw poison.
stats.wizard_spell_4_desc: Shield—an instinctive, reflexive barrier of invisible arcane force.
